item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 04 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Agutaya, Balabac, Bataraza, Cuyo, Magsaysay, Rizal) and #Antique(Caluya) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan(Aborlan, Araceli, Brooke'sPoint, Busuanga, Coron, Dumaran, ElNido, Linapacan, Narra, PuertoPrincesaCity, Quezon, Roxas, SanVicente, Taytay, Kalayaan, Culion and SofronioEspanola) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
